# FreshBooks

FreshBooks is a cloud-based accounting software service designed for small and medium-sized businesses, offering features like invoicing, expense tracking, and time management.

Category: Finance. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/freshbooks/.

## Actions

- **List Businesses**: List all businesses associated with the authenticated user.
- **List Projects**: List all projects for a business.
